no_signed_contract: No signed contract carries this valuation as its trade-in, so it cannot be marked as used: only a signed deal uses a valuation.
pending_contract_carries_it: An open contract carries this valuation as its trade-in; its confirmation would use it. Cancel that contract first.
signed_contract_carries_it: A signed contract carries this valuation as its trade-in, so it stays used.
stamp_too_recent: This valuation was marked as used less than an hour ago; its contract's confirmation may still be in progress. Please try again later.
valuation_not_used: This valuation is not marked as used.
valuation_names_no_car: A valuation names its car: VIN, make and model are required.
provider_quote_required: An auto-i-dat value comes from the provider — use «Get valuation from auto-i-dat» first.
provider_quote_mismatch: This auto-i-dat valuation belongs to another configuration.
provider_quote_stale: The first registration or the mileage differ from the auto-i-dat valuation. Please get it again.
provider_quote_inputs_missing: The auto-i-dat valuation needs the first registration and the mileage.
